action.command: cd /workspace && echo "--- login attempt admin/admin ---"; curl -s -c /tmp/cj.txt http://localhost:8080/login -o /tmp/login.html; TOKEN=$(grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' /tmp/login.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); echo "token_len=${#TOKEN}"; curl -s -b /tmp/cj.txt -c /tmp/cj.txt -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/login -d "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" -d "username=admin" -d "password=admin" 2>&1 | head -15

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && echo \"--- login attempt admin/admin ---\"; curl -s -c /tmp/cj.txt http://localhost:8080/login -o /tmp/login.html; TOKEN=$(grep -o 'name=\"authenticity_token\" value=\"[^\"]*\"' /tmp/login.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*value=\"//;s/\"//'); echo \"token_len=${#TOKEN}\"; curl -s -b /tmp/cj.txt -c /tmp/cj.txt -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/login -d \"authenticity_token=$TOKEN\" -d \"username=admin\" -d \"password=admin\" 2>&1 | head -15", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Attempt HTTP login with admin/admin"}
